firm_data.firm_description: FordHarrison is a labor and employment law firm with 25 offices throughout the United States. Their attorneys provide legal advice, practical counseling, and client service adhering to the principles of the FH Promise.
notable_facts: The firm is managed by managing partner John Monroe and governed by an Executive Committee.
FordHarrison has implemented FHind, a searchable internal database powered by Lexis Search Advantage, for knowledge management.
The firm utilizes the Lexis CaseMap Suite for litigation management.

additional_contacts.name: Lavern J. Wilson
additional_contacts.title: Talent and Recruiting Partner / General Counsel

email.subject: AI for FordHarrison, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Scott,

I noticed FordHarrison has built FHind, a searchable knowledge database powered by Lexis Search Advantage. That kind of investment in internal intelligence infrastructure tells me you're thinking seriously about how technology can compound your firm's labor and employment expertise across 25 offices.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of regional practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into new markets. I'd be happy to stop by your Atlanta office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
